name: Pillow
overview: Scripture presents the pillow primarily as a practical support for the head during rest, often fashioned from stones as seen in Jacob's experience where he used a stone for his pillow and later set it up as a pillar (Genesis 28:11,18). Pillows also appear as objects associated with sleep and protection, such as Saul's spear resting at his bolster while he slept (1 Samuel 26:7). These references highlight the pillow's role as both a physical comfort and a symbol of significant spiritual moments.
